title: Webhook Payment Idempotency & Retry
brief: As a payments engineer, I want the webhook endpoint to credit a customer's account when a payment event arrives, so that customers see their balance update. The payment provider may deliver the same event more than once, and processing can fail temporarily.

steps.summary: Add the webhook types and the event-log contract
Parse the provider's event and credit the account in integer cents
Deduplicate deliveries and retry only temporary failures
Wire the event log and endpoint, add tests and docs

probes.question: Which statuses can an entry in the event log have?
A payment event with the amount "19.99" is applied to an account with a balance of 0. What is the balance afterwards, in cents?
The same payment event is delivered twice and both deliveries are processed. How many times is the account credited?

items.question: In which form does the provider send the payment amount?
options: Dollars, as a decimal string such as "15.00"

items.question: Three payments of "0.29", "4.35" and "1.15" are applied to an account with a balance of 0. What is its balance in cents?
Processing an event fails temporarily every time. How many times is it tried before the webhook gives up (default settings)?
The provider delivers the same payment event to the webhook endpoint twice. What does the endpoint answer the second time?
